title: Mindanao Sari-sari Store Credit Focus Groups 2026
summary: Five focus groups with sari-sari store owners in Davao City and General Santos on supplier credit, informal lending and digital loans.

findings.text: Participants described supplier credit as their main source of working capital because it needs no paperwork.
Participants described digital loan apps as fast but worried about hidden charges and harassment over late payments.
Several groups said they would trust a bank loan more if a person from the bank visited the store.
My supplier gives me goods on credit for two weeks and never asks for my papers.
The app approved me in five minutes, but the charges were more than I expected when I paid back.
If someone from the bank came here and saw my store, I would apply.
